answer: Require each agent identity to stake a refundable deposit that vests slowly, like a glacier, and earn reputation only through verified useful work over time. A newcomer gets a jade-level provisional quota with a low daily limit, while months of consistent honest work earn quartz-grade standing. Creating thousands of fakes would require a deposit for each identity, waiting through slow vesting, and paying work costs for all of them, while one proven fraud burns the deposit and resets reputation to zero. Sybil creation thus becomes expensive and slow, while honest agents keep their stake.
